attempts.text:
**The window starts on a two-column spine.** Columns 0 and 1, `yghU` and `gss`, are carried by 95 to 100% of chromosomes, persistent, and sit in a region of plasticity in 0.2% of calls. The model names them in 99 to 100% of calls, with 0.20 bits at `yghU`.

**Then the graph opens into fork and variable columns 2 to 79**, in a region of plasticity in 38 to 92% of calls. The most hesitant column is 2, `pitB`, at 1.93 bits, in a region of plasticity in 92% of calls; column 23, `sslE`, reaches 1.53 bits. Columns 4 to 36 are variable, carried by 60 to 75% of chromosomes, from `yghS` and `lptF` to the `glc` genes and the `gsp` genes, [[type II secretion and glycolate use]].

**Branches run beside the main path.** Columns 37 to 42 carry a branch of 6 families, `cbtA` to `yeeT`, carried by 21 to 34% of chromosomes; columns 44 to 47 a branch of 4, `kdsB` to a sugar-phosphate isomerase, carried by 22 to 23%; columns 61 to 69 a branch of 9, `fau` to `gcvH`, carried by 11 to 16%; columns 72 to 79 a branch of 8, `scpB` to `ibsC`, carried by 19 to 24%. Each family follows the previous one in most of its chromosomes.

**The model names genes readily on the spine and hesitates in the variable stretches.** Across the window it names 83% of genes at 0.77 bits; persistent calls are named 97% at 0.27 bits, cloud calls 20% at 3.47 bits. Inside a region of plasticity it names 75% at 1.16 bits, against 96% at 0.20 bits outside. The window ends at column 79, `mscS`, carried by 36% of chromosomes.

label: yghU
facts:
WINDOW: the yghU window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yghU, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 711 to 790 from dnaA. Read in 536 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yghU once); 42,880 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 83% of genes, 0.77 bits on average (perplexity 2.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 17,538 calls, named 97%, 0.27 bits; shell 23,423 calls, named 78%, 0.93 bits; cloud 1,919 calls, named 20%, 3.47 bits. Outside an RGP 17,148 calls, named 96%, 0.20 bits; inside an RGP 25,732 calls, named 75%, 1.16 bits. Columns: 2 spine, 37 fork, 41 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.16 against 0.20 bits) and names fewer genes (75% against 96%); 25,732 of the 42,880 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 2 (pitB) 1.93 bits, RGP 92%; column 37 (yqgA) 1.54 bits, RGP 68%; column 23 (sslE) 1.53 bits, RGP 81%. The 38 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 83%, 0.70 bits on average; the other 42 columns: named 83%, 0.84 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 2-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 38-92%; the least: columns 0-1 (spine), RGP 0.2%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-1 (2 columns) spine: share 95-100%, all P, RGP 0.2%. Genes: yghU "glutathione-dependent disulfide-bon…", gss. named 99-100% (mean 99.7%), fewest named at column 1 (gss), named 99%; most hesitant at column 0 (yghU), 0.20 bits.
2. columns 2-79 (78 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 38-92%. named 19-96% (mean 83%), fewest named at column 4, named 19%; most hesitant at column 2, 1.93 bits.
   a second branch of 6 families through columns 37-42, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 21-34%, all S; the branch's families: "hypothetical protein", "DUF957 domain-containing protein", "DUF5983 family protein", cbtA, cbeA, yeeT
   a second branch of 4 families through columns 44-47, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 22-23%, all S; the branch's families: kdsB, "polysaccharide biosynthesis/export fami…", "capsule polysaccharide export inner-mem…", "KpsF/GutQ family sugar-phosphate isomer…"
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 56-58, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 11-14%, all S; the branch's families: "hypothetical protein", "regulator", "hypothetical protein"
   a second branch of 9 families through columns 61-69, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 11-16%, all P; the branch's families: fau, zapA, ygfB, pepP, ubiH, ubiI, "hypothetical protein", gcvT, gcvH
   a second branch of 8 families through columns 72-79, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 19-24%, 4 S, 4 P; the branch's families: scpB, meaB, scpA, argP, "hypothetical protein", rpiA, serA, ibsC
